        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n\n    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    return () =&gt; {\n      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleFileUpload = async (files: FileList | null) =&gt; {\n    if (!files || files.length === 0 || !projectId) return;\n    \n    setIsUploading(true);\n    try {\n      const fileArray = Array.from(files);\n      // 上传文件\n      const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(fileArray, undefined);\n      \n      // 创建来源信息记录\n      for (const uploadedFile of uploadedFiles) {\n        // 如果markdown内容太长，只保存摘要\n        let description = &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&#96;;\n        if (uploadedFile.markdownContent) {\n          // 只保存前500个字符作为描述，完整内容保留在文件记录中\n          const contentPreview = uploadedFile.markdownContent.length &gt; 500\n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent.substring(0, 500) + '...'\n            : uploadedFile.markdownContent;\n          description = contentPreview;\n        }\n        \n        await api.post('/source-information', {\n          source_id: uploadedFile.id || uploadedFile.fileId || &#96;file_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n          title: uploadedFile.name,\n          type: 'external',\n          url: uploadedFile.url,\n          description: description,\n          page_type: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          conversation_id: null\n        });\n      }\n      \n      // 重新加载来源列表\n      await loadSources();\n      \n      // 清空文件输入\n      if (fileInputRefModal.current) {\n        fileInputRefModal.current.value = '';\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n      alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n    } finally {\n      setIsUploading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = async (sourceId: number) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      await api.delete(&#96;/source-information/${sourceId}&#96;);\n      await loadSources();\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除来源失败:', error);\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const UploadModal: React.FC&lt;UploadModalProps&gt; = ({\n  onClose,\n  onUpload,\n  selectedCategoryId,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [file, setFile] = useState&lt;File | null&gt;(null);\n  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');\n  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);\n  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;(null);\n\n  const handleFileSelect = (selectedFile: File) =&gt; {\n    setFile(selectedFile);\n  };\n\n  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(false);\n\n    const droppedFile = e.dataTransfer.files[0];\n    if (droppedFile) {\n      handleFileSelect(droppedFile);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleFileInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const selectedFile = e.target.files?.[0];\n    if (selectedFile) {\n      handleFileSelect(selectedFile);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleUpload = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!file) {\n      alert('请选择文件');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setUploading(true);\n    try {\n      await onUpload(file, {\n        category_id: selectedCategoryId,\n        description: description.trim() || undefined,\n      });\n      // 重置表单\n      setFile(null);\n      setDescription('');\n      if (fileInputRef.current) {\n        fileInputRef.current.value = '';\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('上传失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setUploading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';\n    const k = 1024;\n    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];\n    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));\n    return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center z-50\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst toggleTechPoint =  {\n    setSelectedTechPoints(prev =&gt;\n      prev.includes(techPointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== techPointId)\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const toggleKnowledgePoint = (knowledgePointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedKnowledgePoints(prev =&gt;\n      prev.includes(knowledgePointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== knowledgePointId)\n        : [...prev, knowledgePointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const togglePublicFile = async (fileId: number) =&gt; {\n    if (selectedPublicFiles.includes(fileId)) {\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&gt; prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== fileId));\n    } else {\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&gt; [...prev, fileId]);\n      // 将选中的公共知识库文件添加到项目来源中\n      if (projectId) {\n        const file = publicKnowledgeFiles.find(f =&gt; f.id === fileId);\n        if (file) {\n          try {\n            await api.post('/source-information', {\n              source_id: &#96;public_kb_${file.id}&#96;,\n              title: file.name,\n              type: 'knowledge_base',\n              url: file.file_url || file.file_path,\n              description: file.description || &#96;公共知识库文件: ${file.name}&#96;,\n              page_type: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n              conversation_id: null\n            });\n            // 重新加载来源列表\n            await loadSources();\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('添加公共知识库文件到项目失败:', error);\n          }\n        }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "// 配置multer用于文件上传\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\n  },\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\n    cb(null, &#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&#96;);\n  },\n});\n\nconst upload = multer({\n  storage: storage,\n  limits: {\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\n  },\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&gt; {\n    // 允许的文件类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word\n    const allowedTypes = [\n      'application/pdf',\n      'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint', // .ppt\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation', // .pptx\n      'application/msword', // .doc\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', // .docx\n      'text/plain',\n      'text/markdown',\n    ];\n    // 也允许通过扩展名判断\n    const allowedExtensions = ['.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.doc', '.docx', '.txt', '.md', '.markdown'];\n    const fileExtension = require('path').extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();\n    \n    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype) || allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {\n      cb(null, true);\n    } else {\n      cb(new Error(&#96;不支持的文件类型: ${file.mimetype}。支持的类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word&#96;));\n    }\n  },\n});\n\n// 确保上传目录存在\nconst uploadDir = 'uploads/ai-search/';\nif (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {\n  fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });\n}\n\n// 初始化服务\nconst aiSearchService = new AiSearchService();\nconst fieldMappingService = new FieldMappingService();\nconst createConversationUseCase = new CreateConversationUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst getConversationsUseCase = new GetConversationsUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst getConversationDetailUseCase = new GetConversationDetailUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst sendMessageUseCase = new SendMessageUseCase;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n\n    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    return () =&gt; {\n      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleFileUpload = async (files: FileList | null) =&gt; {\n    if (!files || files.length === 0 || !projectId) return;\n    \n    setIsUploading(true);\n    try {\n      const fileArray = Array.from(files);\n      // 上传文件\n      const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(fileArray, undefined);\n      \n      // 创建来源信息记录\n      for (const uploadedFile of uploadedFiles) {\n        // 如果markdown内容太长，只保存摘要\n        let description = &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&#96;;\n        if (uploadedFile.markdownContent) {\n          // 只保存前500个字符作为描述，完整内容保留在文件记录中\n          const contentPreview = uploadedFile.markdownContent.length &gt; 500\n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent.substring(0, 500) + '...'\n            : uploadedFile.markdownContent;\n          description = contentPreview;\n        }\n        \n        await api.post('/source-information', {\n          source_id: uploadedFile.id || uploadedFile.fileId || &#96;file_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n          title: uploadedFile.name,\n          type: 'external',\n          url: uploadedFile.url,\n          description: description,\n          page_type: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          conversation_id: null\n        });\n      }\n      \n      // 重新加载来源列表\n      await loadSources();\n      \n      // 清空文件输入\n      if (fileInputRefModal.current) {\n        fileInputRefModal.current.value = '';\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n      alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n    } finally {\n      setIsUploading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = async (sourceId: number) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      await api.delete(&#96;/source-information/${sourceId}&#96;);\n      await loadSources();\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除来源失败:', error);\n;\n;",

        "contents": "class AiSearchService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件列表\n   */\n  async getFiles(options?: {\n    category?: string;\n    conversationId?: string;\n    pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release';\n    limit?: number;\n    offset?: number;\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\n  }): Promise&lt;FileUploadResponse[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const params = new URLSearchParams();\n      if (options?.category) {\n        params.set('category', options.category);\n      }\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\n        params.set('conversationId', options.conversationId);\n      }\n      if (options?.pageType) {\n        params.set('pageType', options.pageType);\n      }\n      if (options?.limit) {\n        params.set('limit', String(options.limit));\n      }\n      if (options?.offset) {\n        params.set('offset', String(options.offset));\n      }\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled !== false) {\n        // 默认排除乱码文件名\n        params.set('excludeGarbled', 'true');\n      } else {\n        // 如果明确设置为false，则不排除\n        params.set('excludeGarbled', 'false');\n      }\n\n      const query = params.toString();\n      const response = await api.get(&#96;/ai-search/files${query ? &#96;?${query}&#96; : ''}&#96;);\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        return response.data.data;\n      }\n      return [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 上传文件\n   */\n  async uploadFiles(files: File[], pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&lt;FileUploadResponse[]&gt; {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": "async mergeKnowledgeBaseContent(sources: Source[]): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 准备工作流输入\n   */\n  async prepareWorkflowInput(\n    userQuery: string,\n    sources: Source[],\n    files: File[] = []\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const input: any = {};\n\n    // 合并知识库内容\n    const knowledgeContent = await this.mergeKnowledgeBaseContent(sources);\n    \n    // 组合用户问题和知识库内容\n    let queryContent = userQuery;\n    if (knowledgeContent) {\n      queryContent = &#96;知识库参考内容：\\n\\n${knowledgeContent}\\n\\n用户问题：${userQuery}&#96;;\n    }\n\n    // 准备文件（如果有）\n    if (files.length &gt; 0) {\n      const uploadedFiles = await this.uploadFiles(files);\n      input.files = uploadedFiles.map((f) =&gt; f.url);\n    }\n\n    // 设置查询内容\n    input.query = queryContent;\n    input.sources = sources.map((s) =&gt; ({\n      id: s.id,\n      title: s.title,\n      type: s.type,\n    }));\n\n    return input;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工作流\n   */\n  async executeWorkflow(\n    workflowId: string,\n    input: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ answer: string; outputs?: any }&gt; {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": ";\n}\n\nconst AddSourceModal: React.FC&lt;AddSourceModalProps&gt; = ({\n  onClose,\n  onAddExternalSource,\n  pageType,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [sourceType, setSourceType] = useState&lt;\"url\" | \"file\"&gt;(\"url\");\n  const [url, setUrl] = useState(\"\");\n  const [title, setTitle] = useState(\"\");\n  const [description, setDescription] = useState(\"\");\n  const [files, setFiles] = useState&lt;File[]&gt;([]);\n  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (sourceType === \"url\") {\n      if (!url.trim()) {\n        alert(\"请输入URL\");\n        return;\n      }\n      onAddExternalSource({\n        title: title.trim() || url,\n        type: \"external\",\n        url: url.trim(),\n        description: description.trim(),\n      });\n      setUrl(\"\");\n      setTitle(\"\");\n      setDescription(\"\");\n      onClose();\n    } else {\n      if (files.length === 0) {\n        alert(\"请选择文件\");\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 上传文件到服务器\n      setIsUploading(true);\n      try {\n        const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(files, pageType);\n        \n        // 文件已保存到数据库，不需要通过onAddExternalSource添加\n        // 页面会自动通过loadFiles加载文件列表\n        // 只需要关闭弹窗即可\n        \n        setFiles([]);\n        setTitle(\"\");\n        setDescription(\"\");\n        onClose();\n        \n        // 触发文件列表刷新（通过自定义事件）\n        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('filesUploaded'));\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n        alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n      } finally {\n        setIsUploading(false);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 与指定AI角色对话\n * POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\n * 支持multipart/form-data（带文件）和application/json（不带文件）\n * 注意：必须在 /:id 路由之前定义，否则会被当作 id 处理\n */\nrouter.post('/:id/chat', upload.array('files', 10), async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    \n    // 处理文件上传\n    const uploadedFiles = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n    let fileUrls: string[] = [];\n    \n    if (uploadedFiles &amp;&amp; uploadedFiles.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 保存文件到数据库并获取文件URL\n      const filePromises = uploadedFiles.map(async (file) =&gt; {\n        const filePath = file.path;\n        const fileUrl = &#96;/uploads/ai-roles/${file.filename}&#96;;\n        \n        // 确定文件分类\n        let category = 'general';\n        if (file.mimetype.startsWith('image/')) {\n          category = 'image';\n        } else if (file.mimetype.startsWith('application/pdf') || \n                   file.mimetype.includes('document') || \n                   file.mimetype.includes('word') ||\n                   file.mimetype.includes('text')) {\n          category = 'document';\n        }\n\n        // 处理文件名编码\n        let originalName = file.originalname;\n        try {\n          const hasGarbledChars = /ã€|ç¥|æ|Ã|â€|â€|â€/.test(originalName);\n          if (hasGarbledChars) {\n            const buffer = Buffer.from(originalName, 'latin1');\n            const decoded = buffer.toString('utf8');\n            if (/[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/.test(decoded)) {\n              originalName = decoded;\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          // 忽略编码错误，使用原始文件名\n        }\n\n        // 保存文件记录到数据库\n        const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile\n;\n      };\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 发送消息\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/conversations/:id/messages',\n  ensureTablesInitialized,\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const { id } = req.params;\n      let sourcesValue = req.body.sources;\n      if (typeof sourcesValue === 'string') {\n        try {\n          sourcesValue = JSON.parse(sourcesValue);\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析sources失败，使用原始值', { parseError });\n          sourcesValue = undefined;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const body = {\n        content: req.body.content,\n        sources: Array.isArray(sourcesValue) ? sourcesValue : undefined,\n        contextWindowSize: req.body.contextWindowSize,\n        workflowId: req.body.workflowId,\n        fileList: req.body.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: req.body.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      };\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n\n      const dto = validateDTO(SendMessageSchema, body);\n      const result = await sendMessageUseCase.execute({\n        conversationId: id,\n        content: dto.content,\n        sources: dto.sources,\n        files,\n        contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\n        fileList: dto.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: dto.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      });\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '发送消息失败', result.error.message)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(\n        formatApiResponse(\n          true,\n          result.value,\n          result.value.error ? '发送消息成功，但工作流执行失败' : '发送消息成功'\n        )\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n        const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n  }",

        "contents": "async deleteAIRole(id: string): Promise&lt;AIRoleResponse&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 与AI角色对话\n   */\n  async chatWithRole(\n    roleId: string,\n    query?: string,\n    inputs: any = {},\n    conversationId?: string,\n    files?: File[]\n  ): Promise&lt;ChatResponse&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 如果有文件，使用 FormData 上传\n      if (files &amp;&amp; files.length &gt; 0) {\n        const formData = new FormData();\n        formData.append('query', query || '');\n        formData.append('inputs', JSON.stringify(inputs));\n        if (conversationId) {\n          formData.append('conversationId', conversationId);\n        }\n        \n        // 添加所有文件\n        files.forEach((file) =&gt; {\n          formData.append('files', file);\n        });\n\n        const response = await api.post(&#96;/ai-roles/${roleId}/chat&#96;, formData, {\n          timeout: 420_000, // AI对话请求使用7分钟超时（独立Agent可能需要多轮工具调用，留出缓冲）\n          headers: {\n            'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\n          },\n        });\n        return response.data;\n      } else {\n        // 没有文件，使用 JSON\n        const response = await api.post(&#96;/ai-roles/${roleId}/chat&#96;, {\n          query,\n          inputs,\n          conversationId,\n        }, {\n          timeout: 420_000, // AI对话请求使用7分钟超时（独立Agent可能需要多轮工具调用，留出缓冲）\n        });\n        return response.data;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('AI角色对话失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'AI角色对话失败',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 测试AI角色连接\n   */\n  async testConnection(roleId: string): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try\n  }",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存上传的文件\n   */\n  async saveUploadedFile(file: Express.Multer.File, categoryId?: number | null, description?: string, uploadedBy?: number): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const filePath = this.generateFilePath(file.originalname);\n      \n      // 确保目录存在\n      const dir = path.dirname(filePath);\n      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\n        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\n      }\n\n      // 移动文件到目标位置\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, file.buffer);\n\n      // 创建文件记录\n      const fileData: CreateFileDTO = {\n        category_id: categoryId ?? null,\n        name: file.originalname,\n        file_path: filePath,\n        file_type: file.mimetype,\n        file_size: file.size,\n        description: description,\n        uploaded_by: uploadedBy\n      };\n\n      const fileRecord = await publicKnowledgeModel.createFile(fileData);\n      \n      logger.info('文件上传成功', {\n        fileId: fileRecord.id,\n        fileName: file.originalname,\n        filePath: filePath\n      });\n\n      return {\n        ...fileRecord,\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(filePath)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('保存上传文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件（包括物理文件）\n   */\n  async deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(fileId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return {\n      query: finalQuery,\n      summary: context.summary,\n      keyPhrases: context.keyPhrases,\n      sources: effectiveSources,\n      files:\n        params.files?.map((f) =&gt; ({\n          name: f.originalname,\n          url: &#96;/uploads/ai-search/${f.filename}&#96;,\n          type: f.mimetype,\n        })) || [],\n      fileList: fileListArray, // 文件列表数组\n      knowledgeBaseNames: knowledgeBaseNamesArray, // 知识库名称数组\n      // 注意：使用 Dify 的 conversation_id，不是本地对话ID\n      // 首次对话时为空，Dify 会返回新的 conversation_id\n      conversationId: params.conversation?.difyConversationId || '',\n      history: context.history,\n      historySize: context.historySize,\n      historyLimit: context.historyLimit,\n      metadata: {\n        contextGeneratedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        workflowId: params.workflowId,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 获取文件列表\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/files?pageType=tech-package|press-release\n */\nrouter.get('/files', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    await initializeFileTable();\n\n    const category = req.query.category as string | undefined;\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string | undefined;\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;\n    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined;\n    const excludeGarbled = req.query.excludeGarbled !== 'false'; // 默认排除乱码文件名\n\n    const files = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n      category,\n      conversationId,\n      pageType,\n      limit,\n      offset,\n      excludeGarbled, // 默认排除乱码文件名\n    });\n\n    const fileList = files.map((file) =&gt; ({\n      id: file.file_id,\n      fileId: file.file_id,\n      name: file.original_name,\n      url: file.file_url,\n      type: file.mime_type,\n      size: file.file_size,\n      category: file.category,\n      tags: file.tags ? JSON.parse(file.tags) : [],\n      description: file.description,\n      usageCount: file.usage_count,\n      lastUsedAt: file.last_used_at,\n      createdAt: file.created_at,\n      updatedAt: file.updated_at,\n    }));\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(true, fileList, '获取文件列表成功')\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取文件列表失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除文件（软删除）\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/files/:fileId\n */",

        "contents": "# Dify 文件上传与传递分析\n\n根据 Dify 对话 API 文档，分析文件传递的正确方式。\n\n## 📋 API 文档关键信息\n\n### 1. 文件上传接口 (POST /files/upload)\n\n**请求格式：**\n- Content-Type: &#96;multipart/form-data&#96;\n- 参数：\n  - &#96;file&#96;: 要上传的文件\n  - &#96;user&#96;: 用户标识（必须和发送消息接口的 user 一致）\n\n**响应格式：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"id\": \"72fa9618-8f89-4a37-9b33-7e1178a24a67\",\n  \"name\": \"example.png\",\n  \"size\": 1024,\n  \"extension\": \"png\",\n  \"mime_type\": \"image/png\",\n  \"created_by\": 123,\n  \"created_at\": 1577836800\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 发送消息接口 (POST /chat-messages)\n\n**文件字段格式：**\n\n&#96;files&#96; 字段应该是**对象数组**，每个对象包含：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  type: string;              // 文件类型：document | image | audio | video | custom\n  transfer_method: string;   // 传递方式：local_file | remote_url\n  upload_file_id?: string;   // 文件 ID（仅当 transfer_method 为 local_file 时）\n  url?: string;              // 文件 URL（仅当 transfer_method 为 remote_url 时）\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**文件类型支持：**\n- &#96;document&#96;: TXT, MD, MARKDOWN, PDF, HTML, XLSX, XLS, DOCX, CSV, EML, MSG, PPTX, PPT, XML, EPUB\n- &#96;image&#96;: JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, SVG\n- &#96;audio&#96;: MP3, M4A, WAV, WEBM, AMR\n- &#96;video&#96;: MP4, MOV, MPEG, MPGA\n- &#96;custom&#96;: 其他文件类型\n\n**示例请求：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"query\": \"What are the specs of the iPhone 13 Pro Max?\",\n  \"inputs\": {},\n  \"response_mode\": \"blocking\",\n  \"conversation_id\": \"\",\n  \"user\": \"abc-123\",\n  \"files\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"image\",\n      \"transfer_method\": \"remote_url\",\n      \"url\": \"https://cloud.dify.ai/logo/logo-site.png\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"document\",\n      \"transfer_method\": \"local_file\",\n      \"upload_file_id\": \"72fa9618-8f89-4a37-9b33-7e1178a24a67\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🔧 当前实现分析\n\n### ✅ 正确的部分\n\n1. **文件上传流程正确**：\n   - 通过 &#96;/files/upload&#96; 接口上传文件",

&#96;[已上传 ${attachedFiles.length} 个文件]&#96; : ''),\n      role: 'user',\n      timestamp: new Date(),\n      attachments: attachedFiles.map(file =&gt; ({\n        name: file.name,\n        size: file.size,\n        type: file.type\n      }))\n    };\n\n    setMessages(prev =&gt; [...prev, userMessage]);\n    const currentInput = inputMessage.trim();\n    const currentFiles = [...attachedFiles];\n    setInputMessage('');\n    setAttachedFiles([]);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      const result = await aiRoleService.chatWithRole(\n        roleConfig.id,\n        currentInput || undefined,\n        {},\n        currentConversationId,\n        currentFiles.length &gt; 0 ?         "contents": "const AISearchPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 先尝试清理乱码文件\n      try {\n        const cleanupApi = await import(\"../services/api\");\n        await cleanupApi.default.delete('/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup');\n      } catch (error) {\n        // 清理失败不影响文件列表加载\n        console.warn('清理乱码文件失败:', error);\n      }\n\n      const files = await aiSearchService.getFiles({ pageType });\n      // 将文件转换为Source格式\n      const fileSources: Source[] = files.map((file) =&gt; ({\n        id: &#96;file_${file.id || file.fileId}&#96;,\n        title: file.name,\n        type: 'external' as const,\n        url: file.url,\n        description: &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(file.size)}&#96;,\n      }));\n      \n      // 完全替换文件来源，避免重复\n      setSources((prev) =&gt; {\n        // 保留非文件来源（知识库来源等）\n        const nonFileSources = prev.filter((s) =&gt; !s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n        // 使用数据库中的文件列表，完全替换文件来源\n        return [...nonFileSources, ...fileSources];\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载文件列表失败:', error);\n    }\n  }, [pageType]);\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\n  };\n\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"加载工作流列表失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"加载工作流列表失败\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    } finally {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [reportError]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&gt;\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "async (req, res) =&gt; {\nconst filePromises = async (file) =&gt; {\n\n\n        // 保存文件记录到数据库\n        const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile({\n          original_name: originalName,\n          stored_name: file.filename,\n          file_path: filePath,\n          file_url: fileUrl,\n          mime_type: file.mimetype,\n          file_size: file.size,\n          category,\n          conversation_id: req.body.conversationId || undefined,\n        });\n\n        return fileUrl;\n      });\n      \n      fileUrls = await Promise.all(filePromises);\n    }\n    \n    // 获取请求参数（支持JSON和FormData）\n    let query: string = '';\n    let inputs: any = {};\n    let conversationId: string = '';\n    \n    if (req.headers['content-type']?.includes('multipart/form-data')) {\n      // FormData格式\n      query = req.body.query || '';\n      try {\n        inputs = typeof req.body.inputs === 'string' ? JSON.parse(req.body.inputs) : (req.body.inputs || {});\n      } catch (e) {\n        inputs = req.body.inputs || {};\n      }\n      conversationId = req.body.conversationId || '';\n    } else {\n      // JSON格式\n      query = req.body.query || '';\n      inputs = req.body.inputs || {};\n      conversationId = req.body.conversationId || '';\n    }\n    \n    // 获取角色配置\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(id);\n    \n    if (!role) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, 'AI角色不存在'));\n    }\n    \n    if (!role.enabled) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, 'AI角色已禁用'));\n    }\n    \n    // 验证查询参数：如果没有查询内容，至少要有文件上传\n    if ((!query || query.trim() === '') &amp;&amp; fileUrls.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'query',\n        message: '查询内容或文件至少需要提供一个'\n      }]));\n    }\n    \n    console.log('AI角色对话请求:',\n\n}",

  "contents": "import { db } from '@/config/database';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport crypto from 'crypto';\nimport fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\n\nexport interface FileRecord {\n  id: number;\n  file_id: string;\n  original_name: string;\n  stored_name: string;\n  file_path: string;\n  file_url: string;\n  mime_type: string;\n  file_size: number;\n  file_hash?: string;\n  category: string;\n  tags?: string;\n  description?: string;\n  uploader_id?: string;\n  conversation_id?: string;\n  usage_count: number;\n  last_used_at?: string;\n  status: 'active' | 'archived' | 'deleted';\n  metadata?: string;\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n}\n\nexport interface CreateFileParams {\n  original_name: string;\n  stored_name: string;\n  file_path: string;\n  file_url: string;\n  mime_type: string;\n  file_size: number;\n  file_hash?: string;\n  category?: string;\n  tags?: string[];\n  description?: string;\n  uploader_id?: string;\n  conversation_id?: string;\n  metadata?: any;\n}\n\nexport class FileService {\n  /**\n   * 初始化文件表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n          original_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          stored_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n          file_url TEXT NOT NULL,\n          mime_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n          file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          file_hash TEXT,\n          category TEXT DEFAULT 'general',\n          tags TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          uploader_id TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n          last_used_at DATETIME,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          metadata TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        );\n\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);\n      &#96;;\n\n      // 执行多个SQL语句\n      const statements = sql.split(';').filter(s =&gt; s.trim());\n      for (const statement of statements) {\n        if (statement.trim()) {\n          await db.query(statement);\n        }\n      }\n      logger.info('文件表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('文件表初始化失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 计算文件哈希值\n   */\n  private async calculateFileHash(filePath: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');\n      const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);\n\n      stream.on('data', (data) =&gt; hash.update(data));\n      stream.on('end', () =&gt; resolve(hash.digest('hex')));\n      stream.on('error', reject);\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成文件ID\n   */\n  private generateFileId(): string {\n    return &#96;file_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15)}&#96;;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建文件记录\n   */\n  async createFile(params: CreateFileParams): Promise&lt;FileRecord&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 计算文件哈希值\n      let fileHash: string | undefined;\n      if (fs.existsSync(params.file_path)) {\n        fileHash = await this.calculateFileHash(params.file_path);\n        \n        // 检查是否已存在相同哈希的文件\n        const existing = await this.findByHash(fileHash);\n        if (existing) {\n          // 如果文件已存在，增加使用次数并返回现有记录\n          await this.incrementUsageCount(existing.file_id);\n          return existing;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const fileId = this.generateFileId();\n      const tagsJson = params.tags ? JSON.stringify(params.tags) : null;\n      const metadataJson = params.metadata ? JSON.stringify(params.metadata) : null;\n\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO files (\n          file_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_url,\n          mime_type, file_size, file_hash, category, tags, description,\n          uploader_id, conversation_id, metadata\n        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      &#96;;\n\n      await db.query(sql, [\n        fileId,\n        params.original_name,\n        params.stored_name,\n        params.file_path,\n        params.file_url,\n        params.mime_type,\n        params.file_size,\n        fileHash || null,\n        params.category || 'general',\n        tagsJson,\n        params.description || null,\n        params.uploader_id || null,\n        params.conversation_id || null,\n        metadataJson,\n      ]);\n\n      const file = await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\n      if (!file) {\n        throw new Error('创建文件记录失败');\n      }\n\n      logger.info('文件记录创建成功', { fileId, originalName: params.original_name });\n      return file;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('创建文件记录失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据文件ID获取文件记录\n   */\n  async getFileByFileId(fileId: string): Promise&lt;FileRecord | null&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_id = ? AND status = 'active'&#96;;\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\n      return rows.length &gt; 0 ? (rows[0] as FileRecord) : null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件记录失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据哈希值查找文件\n   */\n  async findByHash(fileHash: string): Promise&lt;FileRecord | null&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_hash = ? AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1&#96;;\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, [fileHash]);\n      return rows.length &gt; 0 ? (rows[0] as FileRecord) : null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('根据哈希查找文件失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 增加文件使用次数\n   */\n  async incrementUsageCount(fileId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;\n        UPDATE files \n        SET usage_count = usage_count + 1,\n            last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        WHERE file_id = ?\n      &#96;;\n      await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('增加文件使用次数失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有文件列表\n   */\n  async getAllFiles(options?: {\n    category?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    conversationId?: string;\n    pageType?: string; // 页面类型：'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    limit?: number;\n    offset?: number;\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\n  }): Promise&lt;FileRecord[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      let sql = &#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE 1=1&#96;;\n      const params: any[] = [];\n\n      if (options?.category) {\n        sql += &#96; AND category = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.category);\n      }\n\n      if (options?.status) {\n        sql += &#96; AND status = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.status);\n      } else {\n        sql += &#96; AND status = 'active'&#96;;\n      }\n\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\n        sql += &#96; AND conversation_id = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.conversationId);\n      }\n\n      // 按页面类型过滤（通过metadata字段）\n      if (options?.pageType) {\n        // 只返回metadata中包含指定pageType的文件\n        sql += &#96; AND metadata LIKE ?&#96;;\n        params.push(&#96;%\"pageType\":\"${options.pageType}\"%&#96;);\n      }\n      // 如果没有指定pageType，返回所有文件（包括没有metadata的旧文件）\n\n      // 排除乱码文件名\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled) {\n        sql += &#96; AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ã€%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ç¥%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%æ%'&#96;;\n      }\n\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&#96;;\n\n      if (options?.limit) {\n        sql += &#96; LIMIT ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.limit);\n      }\n\n      if (options?.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.offset);\n      }\n\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, params);\n      \n      // 基于文件哈希去重，只保留最新的记录\n      const fileMap = new Map&lt;string, FileRecord&gt;();\n      for (const row of rows as FileRecord[]) {\n        if (row.file_hash) {\n          const existing = fileMap.get(row.file_hash);\n          if (!existing || new Date(row.created_at) &gt; new Date(existing.created_at)) {\n            fileMap.set(row.file_hash, row);\n          }\n        } else {\n          // 没有哈希值的文件，使用file_id作为key\n          fileMap.set(row.file_id, row);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      return Array.from(fileMap.values());\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新文件信息\n   */\n  async updateFile(fileId: string, updates: {\n    description?: string;\n    tags?: string[];\n    category?: string;\n    metadata?: any;\n  }): Promise&lt;FileRecord | null&gt; {\n    try {\n      const setClauses: string[] = [];\n      const params: any[] = [];\n\n      if (updates.description !== undefined) {\n        setClauses.push('description = ?');\n        params.push(updates.description);\n      }\n\n      if (updates.tags !== undefined) {\n        setClauses.push('tags = ?');\n        params.push(JSON.stringify(updates.tags));\n      }\n\n      if (updates.category !== undefined) {\n        setClauses.push('category = ?');\n        params.push(updates.category);\n      }\n\n      if (updates.metadata !== undefined) {\n        setClauses.push('metadata = ?');\n        params.push(JSON.stringify(updates.metadata));\n      }\n\n      if (setClauses.length === 0) {\n        return await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\n      }\n\n      setClauses.push('updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');\n      params.push(fileId);\n\n      const sql = &#96;UPDATE files SET ${setClauses.join(', ')} WHERE file_id = ?&#96;;\n      await db.query(sql, params);\n\n      return await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('更新文件信息失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件（软删除）\n   */\n  async deleteFile(fileId: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;UPDATE files SET status = 'deleted', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = ?&#96;;\n      await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除文件失败:', error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const fileService = new FileService();\n\n",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO source_information (\n        source_id, title, type, url, description, page_type, \n        conversation_id, metadata, status, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.source_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.type,\n      data.url || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.page_type || null,\n      data.conversation_id || null,\n      data.metadata ?         "contents": "// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/batch', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const dataList: CreateSourceInformationDTO[] = req.body;\n    \n    if (!Array.isArray(dataList) || dataList.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '请提供有效的来源信息数组'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证每个数据项\n    for (const data of dataList) {\n      if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '每个来源信息必须包含source_id、title和type字段'\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const results = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformationBatch(dataList);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: results,\n      message: &#96;成功创建${results.length}条来源信息&#96;\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('批量创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '批量创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 获取来源信息列表（必须在参数路由之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sourceInfoList: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt;[] = sources.map((source) =&gt; {\n        // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n        const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n        if (source.category) {\n          metadata.category = source.category;\n        }\n        \n        return {\n          source_id: source.id,\n          title: source.title,\n          type: source.type,\n          url: source.url,\n          description: source.description,\n          page_type: pageType as any,\n          conversation_id: conversationId,\n          status: \"active\",\n          metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n        };\n      });\n\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息:', {\n        count: sourceInfoList.length,\n        pageType,\n        conversationId,\n        sources: sourceInfoList.map(s =&gt; ({ source_id: s.source_id, title: s.title }))\n      });\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information/batch\", sourceInfoList);\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存响应:', {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        dataCount: response.data.data?.length || 0,\n        error: response.data.error\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        data: response.data.data,\n        error: response.data.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\", {\n        message: error.message,\n        response: error.response?.data,\n        status: error.response?.status\n      });\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \"批量保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID加载来源信息\n   */\n  async loadSourceInformationByConversationId(\n    conversationId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: Source[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n\n    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    return () =&gt; {\n      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleFileUpload = async (files: FileList | null) =&gt; {\n    if (!files || files.length === 0 || !projectId) return;\n    \n    setIsUploading(true);\n    try {\n      const fileArray = Array.from(files);\n      // 上传文件\n      const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(fileArray, undefined);\n      \n      // 创建来源信息记录\n      for (const uploadedFile of uploadedFiles) {\n        // 如果markdown内容太长，只保存摘要\n        let description = &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&#96;;\n        if (uploadedFile.markdownContent) {\n          // 只保存前500个字符作为描述，完整内容保留在文件记录中\n          const contentPreview = uploadedFile.markdownContent.length &gt; 500\n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent.substring(0, 500) + '...'\n            : uploadedFile.markdownContent;\n          description = contentPreview;\n        }\n        \n        await api.post('/source-information', {\n          source_id: uploadedFile.id || uploadedFile.fileId || &#96;file_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n          title: uploadedFile.name,\n          type: 'external',\n          url: uploadedFile.url,\n          description: description,\n          page_type: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          conversation_id: null\n        });\n      }\n      \n      // 重新加载来源列表\n      await loadSources();\n      \n      // 清空文件输入\n      if (fileInputRefModal.current) {\n        fileInputRefModal.current.value = '';\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n      alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n    } finally {\n      setIsUploading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = async (sourceId: number) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      await api.delete(&#96;/source-information/${sourceId}&#96;);\n      await loadSources();\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除来源失败:', error);\n;\n;",

        "contents": "// 获取来源信息列表（必须在参数路由之前）\nrouter.get('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 20;\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string;\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string;\n    const type = req.query.type as string;\n    const status = req.query.status as string || 'active';\n\n    const where: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n    if (pageType) where.page_type = pageType;\n    if (conversationId) where.conversation_id = conversationId;\n    if (type) where.type = type;\n    if (status) where.status = status;\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n      where: Object.keys(where).length &gt; 0 ? where : undefined\n    };\n\n    const result = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationList(options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nconstructor() {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // SQLite 需要逐个执行语句\n      const statements = [\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n          url TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(created_at)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n         },
        "contents": "/**\n * 创建AI角色\n * POST /api/v1/ai-roles\n */\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { name, description, avatar, systemPrompt, provider, difyConfig, agentConfig, enabled, source } = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!name || !description) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'name/description',\n        message: '角色名称和描述不能为空'\n      }]));\n    }\n\n    const actualProvider = provider || 'dify';\n    \n    // 根据 provider 验证配置\n    if (actualProvider === 'dify') {\n      if (!difyConfig) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n          field: 'difyConfig',\n          message: 'Dify配置不能为空'\n        }]));\n      }\n      if (!difyConfig.apiUrl || !difyConfig.apiKey || !difyConfig.connectionType) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n          field: 'difyConfig',\n          message: 'Dify配置必须包含apiUrl、apiKey和connectionType'\n        }]));\n      }\n    } else if (actualProvider === 'direct-agent') {\n      if (!agentConfig) {\n        return\n}",
        "signatures": {},

## 修复内容

### 1. **增强错误处理和调试日志**
   - 在 `handleFileUpload` 中添加详细日志，记录上传过程
   - 在 `loadSources` 中添加日志，记录加载的来源信息
   - 在资源清单更新时添加日志，便于追踪文件识别

### 2. **改进上传流程**
   - 确保上传完成后再关闭弹窗（拖拽和点击上传）
   - 添加成功提示，显示上传的文件数量
   - 改进错误处理，单个文件失败不影响其他文件

### 3. **优化来源信息创建**
   - 为每个文件生成唯一的 `source_id`，避免冲突
   - 添加错误捕获，确保单个文件失败不影响整体流程

## 测试建议

1. 打开浏览器开发者工具（F12），查看 Console 标签
2. 上传一个 PDF 文件
3. 查看控制台日志，应该能看到：
   - `[文件上传] 开始上传文件`
   - `[文件上传] 文件上传成功`
   - `[文件上传] 创建来源信息`
   - `[加载来源] 加载的来源数量`
   - `[资源清单] 识别为文件`

4. 检查右侧“已关联技术信息”区域，应该能看到上传的文件显示在“已上传文件”列表中

## 可能的问题排查

如果文件仍然不显示，请检查控制台日志：

1. 如果看到“创建来源信息失败”，可能是后端 API 问题
2. 如果看到“加载的来源数量: 0”，可能是查询参数问题
3. 如果看到文件被识别但不在列表中，可能是过滤逻辑问题

请测试并告知结果。如果仍有问题，请提供控制台日志，我会继续排查。

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n      const pageTypeToLoad = projectId ? &#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&#96; : config.pageType;\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', pageTypeToLoad);\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(pageTypeToLoad);\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\n        success: sourceResult.success,\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n        error: sourceResult.error\n      });\n      \n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          // 合并现有来源和数据库中的来源，避免重复\n          const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n          // 先添加现有来源\n          prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          // 再添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n          sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length);\n          return merged;\n        });\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\n      } else {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有找到页面类型的来源信息');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载页面类型来源信息失败:\", error);\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\n    }\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n    \n    setConfiguredResources({\n      files: files,\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&gt; selectedTechPoints.includes(tp.id)),\n      knowledgePoints: knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&gt; selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id))\n    });\n  }, [sources, selectedTechPoints, selectedKnowledgePoints, techPoints, knowledgePoints]);\n\n  const loadProject = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    try {\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setProject(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadSources = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    try {\n      // 获取项目的来源信息\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\n        params: {\n          pageType: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100\n        }\n      });\n      console.log('[加载来源] API响应:', response.data);\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        const loadedSources = response.data.data;\n        console.log('[加载来源] 加载的来源数量:', loadedSources.length);\n        console.log('[加载来源] 来源列表:', loadedSources.map((s: SourceInformation) =&gt; ({\n          id: s.id,\n          title: s.title,\n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          page_type: (s as any).page_type\n        })));\n        setSources(loadedSources);\n      } else {\n        console.warn('[加载来源] API返回失败或没有数据:', response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[加载来源] 加载来源信息失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 检查历史记录（用于决定显示哪个视图）\n  const checkHistoryRecords = async ()\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有来源信息\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;SourceInformation&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].count : countResult.count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    const data = rows.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as SourceInformation[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表\n   */\n  async findByConversationId(conversationId: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformation(\n    source: Source,\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation;\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n      const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n      if (source.category) {\n        metadata.category = source.category;\n      }\n      \n      const sourceInfo: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt; = {\n        source_id: source.id,\n        title: source.title,\n        type: source.type,\n        url: source.url,\n        description: source.description,\n        page_type: pageType as any,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        status: \"active\",\n        metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n      };\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information\", sourceInfo);\n      return {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        data: response.data.data,\n        error: response.data.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: \"保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n        \n        // 从数据库加载该对话的来源信息（仅在非追加模式下加载，避免重复）\n        if (!options?.append) {\n          try {\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载对话来源信息:', conversationId);\n            const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 对话来源加载结果:', {\n              success: sourceResult.success,\n              count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n              error: sourceResult.error\n            });\n            \n            const dbSources = sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data ? sourceResult.data : [];\n            const conversationSources = detail.sources || [];\n            \n            // 合并所有来源：现有来源 + 对话来源 + 数据库来源\n            setSources(prev =&gt; {\n              const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n              \n              // 1. 先添加现有的来源（包括页面类型的来源）\n              prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 2. 添加对话中的来源\n              conversationSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 3. 添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n              dbSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n              console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n                prev: prev.length,\n                conversation: conversationSources.length,\n                db: dbSources.length\n              });\n              return merged;\n            });\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载对话来源信息失败:\", error);\n            // 如果加载失败，至少保留对话中的来源\n    }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "// 根据source_id获取来源信息（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/source-id/:sourceId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { sourceId } = req.params;\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationBySourceId(sourceId);\n    \n    if (!sourceInformation) {\n      return res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '来源信息不存在'\n      });\n    }\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据ID获取来源信息（必须在最后，因为会匹配任何路径）",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./frontend/src/services/sourceService.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 416,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sourceInfoList: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt;[] = sources.map((source) =&gt; {\n        // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n        const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n        if (source.category) {\n          metadata.category = source.category;\n        }\n        \n        return {\n          source_id: source.id,\n          title: source.title,\n          type: source.type,\n          url: source.url,\n          description: source.description,\n          page_type: pageType as any,\n          conversation_id: conversationId,\n          status: \"active\",\n          metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n        };\n      });\n\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息:', {\n        count: sourceInfoList.length,\n        pageType,\n        conversationId,\n        sources: sourceInfoList.map(s =&gt; ({ source_id: s.source_id, title: s.title }))\n      });\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information/batch\", sourceInfoList);\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存响应:', {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        dataCount: response.data.data?.length || 0,\n        error: response.data.error\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        data: response.data.data,\n        error: response.data.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\", {\n        message: error.message,\n        response: error.response?.data,\n        status: error.response?.status\n      });\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \"批量保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID加载来源信息\n   */\n  async loadSourceInformationByConversationId(\n    conversationId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: Source[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadPageTypeSources = \n [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const urlSourceIds = searchParams.getAll('sourceId'); // 获取所有的 sourceId 参数\n    if (urlSourceIds.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; sources.length &gt; 0) {\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 检测到 URL 参数中的 sourceIds:', urlSourceIds);\n      \n      const newSelectedIds: string[] = [];\n      let hasNewSelection = false;\n      \n      // 检查每个 sourceId 是否存在于来源中，并添加到选中列表\n      urlSourceIds.forEach(sourceId =&gt; {\n        const foundSource = sources.find(s =&gt; s.id === sourceId);\n        if (foundSource) {\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 找到匹配的来源，自动选中:', foundSource.title);\n          newSelectedIds.push(sourceId);\n          hasNewSelection = true;\n        } else {\n          console.warn('[SourceInfo] URL 参数中的 sourceId 不存在于加载的来源中:', sourceId);\n        }\n      });\n      \n      // 如果有新的选中项，更新选中列表\n      if (hasNewSelection) {\n        setSelectedSourceIds(prev =&gt; {\n          const combined = [...prev];\n          newSelectedIds.forEach(id =&gt; {\n            if (!combined.includes(id)) {\n              combined.push(id);\n            }\n          });\n          return combined;\n        });\n        \n        // 清除 URL 参数，避免刷新时重复选中\n        const newSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);\n        newSearchParams.delete('sourceId');\n        setSearchParams(newSearchParams, { replace: true });\n      }\n    }\n  }, [sources, searchParams, setSearchParams]);\n\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "// 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/conversation/:conversationId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const { conversationId } = req.params;\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取对话来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取对话来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据页面类型获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "export class FileService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有文件列表\n   */\n  async getAllFiles(options?: {\n    category?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    conversationId?: string;\n    pageType?: string; // 页面类型：'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    limit?: number;\n    offset?: number;\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\n  }): Promise&lt;FileRecord[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      let sql = &#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE 1=1&#96;;\n      const params: any[] = [];\n\n      if (options?.category) {\n        sql += &#96; AND category = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.category);\n      }\n\n      if (options?.status) {\n        sql += &#96; AND status = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.status);\n      } else {\n        sql += &#96; AND status = 'active'&#96;;\n      }\n\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\n        sql += &#96; AND conversation_id = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.conversationId);\n      }\n\n      // 按页面类型过滤（通过metadata字段）\n      if (options?.pageType) {\n        // 只返回metadata中包含指定pageType的文件\n        sql += &#96; AND metadata LIKE ?&#96;;\n        params.push(&#96;%\"pageType\":\"${options.pageType}\"%&#96;);\n      }\n      // 如果没有指定pageType，返回所有文件（包括没有metadata的旧文件）\n\n      // 排除乱码文件名\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled) {\n        sql += &#96; AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ã€%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ç¥%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%æ%'&#96;;\n      }\n\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&#96;;\n\n      if (options?.limit) {\n        sql += &#96; LIMIT ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.limit);\n      }\n\n      if (options?.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.offset);\n      }\n\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, params);\n      \n      // 基于文件哈希去重，只保留最新的记录\n      const fileMap = new Map&lt;string, FileRecord&gt;();\n      for (const row of rows as FileRecord[]) {\n        if (row.file_hash) {\n          const existing = fileMap.get(row.file_hash);\n  }\n}",

### 1. **增强文件识别逻辑**
   - 不仅检查 URL 是否以 `/uploads/` 开头
   - 还检查是否包含文件扩展名（`.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx` 等）
   - 更准确地识别上传的文件

### 2. **详细调试日志**
   - 显示每个来源的 URL 详情
   - 显示为什么某个来源被识别或不被识别为文件
   - 显示文件列表的具体内容

### 3. **优化数据同步**
   - 添加延迟和二次加载，确保数据库更新后正确刷新

## 测试步骤

1. 刷新页面，清除旧的日志
2. 上传一个 PDF 文件
3. 查看控制台日志，应该能看到：
   - `[文件上传] 开始上传文件`
   - `[文件上传] 文件上传成功`
   - `[文件上传] 创建来源信息`
   - `[加载来源] 来源列表详情` - 这里会显示每个来源的 URL 详情
   - `[资源清单] ✓ 识别为文件` 或 `[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件` - 显示识别结果和原因
   - `[资源清单] 更新配置资源` - 显示文件数量

如果文件仍然不显示，请查看控制台日志中的 `[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件` 部分，它会显示为什么没有被识别，这样我们可以进一步修复。

请测试并告知结果。

JSON.stringify(data.metadata) : null,\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const id = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const sourceInfo = await this.findById(id);\n    if (!sourceInfo) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create source information');\n    }\n    \n    return sourceInfo;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nconstructor() {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // SQLite 需要逐个执行语句\n      const statements = [\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n          url TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n          if (error?.message?.includes('already exists') || \n              error?.message?.includes('duplicate') ||\n              error?.code === 'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT') {\n            console.warn('表或索引可能已存在，继续执行:', error.message);\n            continue;\n          }\n          throw error;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('来源信息表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}",

            "line": 416,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sourceInfoList: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt;[] = sources.map((source) =&gt; {\n        // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n        const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n        if (source.category) {\n          metadata.category = source.category;\n        }\n        \n        return {\n          source_id: source.id,\n          title: source.title,\n          type: source.type,\n          url: source.url,\n          description: source.description,\n          page_type: pageType as any,\n          conversation_id: conversationId,\n          status: \"active\",\n          metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n        };\n      });\n\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息:', {\n        count: sourceInfoList.length,\n        pageType,\n        conversationId,\n        sources: sourceInfoList.map(s =&gt; ({ source_id: s.source_id, title: s.title }))\n      });\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information/batch\", sourceInfoList);\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存响应:', {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        dataCount: response.data.data?.length || 0,\n        error: response.data.error\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        data: response.data.data,\n        error: response.data.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\", {\n        message: error.message,\n        response: error.response?.data,\n        status: error.response?.status\n      });\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \"批量保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID加载来源信息\n   */\n  async loadSourceInformationByConversationId(\n    conversationId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: Source[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "// 创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const data: CreateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'source_id、title和type为必填字段'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证type字段\n    if (!['knowledge_base', 'external'].includes(data.type)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'type必须是knowledge_base或external'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformation(data);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息创建成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post",
